help.dragon-card.title: Dragon Body card
help.dragon-card.decoration.title: Dragon card
help.dragon-card.decoration.desc: Marks the beginning or the end of the Dragon Body. This card plays no role in the rules.
help.dragon-card.decoration.zone: The area in front of the dragon, between the Dragon Tail card and the Dragon Head card, is called the Bombing Zone: this is where the Dragon Body cards and the Firecracker cards placed underneath are laid out, always in ascending order of Vitality.
help.dragon-card.role: The Dragon Body cards form the dragon's row in the Bombing Zone. Each turn, the players stack their Firecracker cards under these cards to try to explode them and take them.
help.dragon-card.vitality: Vitality Points: {vitality}. The sum of the Power Values of the Firecracker cards placed under this card must meet or exceed this value to explode the Dragon.
help.dragon-card.explosion: As soon as the total Power placed on this slot is equal to or higher than its Vitality Points, the card explodes: the player who has just placed the triggering card takes it immediately, and all the associated Firecracker cards are placed in the discard pile. If the total Power is lower, the cards remain in place for the next turn.
help.dragon-card.points: Worth {points} Victory Points if you take it.
help.dragon-card.malus: In Chinese culture, “4” represents bad luck: taking this card causes you to lose points.
help.dragon-card.hand-limit-bonus: Taking this card increases your hand limit by 1 until the end of the round.
help.dragon-card.refill: When a card explodes and is taken, a new Dragon Body card is drawn from the Dragon deck to fill the empty space, and the row is rearranged in ascending order of Vitality. If the Dragon deck no longer holds enough cards to fill the empty spaces, the round ends immediately.
help.firecracker-card.title: Firecracker card
help.firecracker-card.role: Firecracker cards are your main resource. Each turn, choose 1 from your hand (2 in a 2-player game) and place it face down: once all players have selected a card, they are revealed simultaneously and automatically placed under the Dragon Body cards.
help.firecracker-card.order: The player with the lowest Power Value begins and places their card under the first Dragon Body slot on the left; then, in ascending order, each player places their card (in case of a tie, the player with fewer Lanterns on their card goes first). Rocket cards are set aside and placed last, in ascending order of their Lanterns.
help.firecracker-card.string.title: String of Firecrackers
help.firecracker-card.string: When you play this card, draw 1 Firecracker card from the deck and add its value to the total Power of the slot. If the drawn card is a Special Firecracker card, its effect is ignored.
help.firecracker-card.rocket.title: Rocket
help.firecracker-card.rocket: You will place it last, under any Dragon Body card still present, whenever you choose. If the Vitality threshold of that slot is reached, you take that card.
help.firecracker-card.double.title: Double Firecracker
help.firecracker-card.double: If the Vitality threshold of the slot is reached, you double the Victory Points of the Dragon Body card you take. Negative points are also doubled.
help.rule.title: Game Flow
help.rule.intro: The game is played over several rounds, each consisting of multiple turns. Each turn, add together the Power Values of your Firecracker cards to meet or exceed the Vitality Points of a Dragon Body card and explode it.
help.rule.step1.title: 1. Choose Firecracker Cards
help.rule.step1.desc: Each player chooses 1 Firecracker card from their hand and places it face down on the table. Once all players have selected a card, they are revealed simultaneously.
help.rule.step2.title: 2. Place Firecracker Cards
help.rule.step2.desc1: The player with the lowest Power Value begins and places their Firecracker card in the Bombing Zone, under the first Dragon Body slot on the left. (In case of a tie, the player with fewer Lanterns on their card goes first.) Then, in ascending order, each player places their Firecracker card from left to right. Rocket cards are set aside and placed last, in ascending order of their Lanterns, under any Dragon Body card their owner chooses.
help.rule.step2.desc2: The Power Values of the Firecracker cards in each position are added together. As soon as the total Power is equal to or higher than the Vitality Points of the corresponding Dragon Body card, it explodes: the player who has just placed the triggering card takes it face up, and all the associated Firecracker cards are placed in the discard pile.
help.rule.step3.title: 3. Complete the Dragon
help.rule.step3.desc: Once all players have placed their cards, draw cards from the Dragon deck to fill the empty spaces in the Dragon Body, then rearrange the cards in ascending order. If there are not enough cards in the Dragon deck to fill the empty spaces, the round ends immediately and each player's Victory Points are recorded.
help.rule.step4.title: 4. Draw Cards
help.rule.step4.desc: Each player draws Firecracker cards until they reach their hand limit (3 cards normally, or more with certain bonuses). If the Firecracker deck is empty, shuffle the discard pile to form a new deck.
help.rule.end-of-game.title: End of Game
help.rule.end-of-game.desc: The game ends when a player reaches 50 points or more at the end of a round. The player with the highest total wins the game. In case of a tie, the player with the fewest Dragon Body cards wins; if there is still a tie, all tied players share the victory.
help.rule.two-players.title: 2-Player Rules
help.rule.two-players.desc: Only 4 Dragon Body cards are placed between the Dragon Tail and the Dragon Head, the hand limit is 4 cards, and each player chooses and plays 2 Firecracker cards per turn instead of just one.
tuto.welcome:
Welcome to the <bold>Dragon Bomb</bold> tutorial.

Dragon Bomb is a celebration of the Hakka people that takes place in Miaoli, Taiwan, during the Lantern Festival.
tuto.goal: In this game, your goal is to take <bold>Dragon Body</bold> cards.
tuto.secret-choice: To take the <bold>Dragon Body</bold> cards, each turn every player secretly chooses a <bold>Firecracker card</bold> from their hand.
tuto.choose-mine: Choose this card by dragging it here.
tuto.reveal: The selected Firecracker cards are revealed.
tuto.place-first: The player who played the <bold>Firecracker card</bold> with the lowest <bold>Power Value</bold> begins: DuGeWei places their Power 5 Firecracker in the <bold>Bombing Zone</bold>, under the first Dragon Body slot on the left.
tuto.place-second: Yu-Cin Huang goes on and places their Power 7 Firecracker in the second position.
tuto.place-third: Finally, you place your Power 10 Firecracker in the last position.
tuto.round2: A new round begins. Choose this card.
tuto.place-lowest-first: You played the Firecracker with the lowest Power Value, so you place it first.
tuto.chapelet-effect: Some Firecrackers have a <bold>special effect</bold>. When the <bold>String of Firecrackers</bold> is played, draw 1 Firecracker card and add it to the Bombing Zone.
tuto.vitality-points: Every Dragon Body card has <bold>Vitality Points</bold> (11 for this one), and <bold>Victory Points</bold> (3 here).
tuto.explosion-rule: As soon as the total Power of the Firecrackers is equal to or higher than the <bold>Vitality Points</bold> of the Dragon Body card, the player who played the last Firecracker takes that card.
tuto.tie-break: When 2 players play Firecrackers with the same Power Value, the player with <bold>fewer Lanterns</bold> on their card goes first: here, DuGeWei places their 5 Firecracker first, because it has 2 Lanterns, while Yu-Cin Huang's has 5.
tuto.dugewei-wins: DuGeWei takes this Dragon Body card.
tuto.special-firecrackers: The Firecracker cards 1, 2 and 3 each have a <bold>special effect</bold>: click on a card to learn its effect!
tuto.special-dragons: The Dragon Body cards 4 and 13 are special: click on them to learn what makes them different.
tuto.end-of-round: The round ends when there are not enough Dragon Body cards to fill the empty spaces: each player then records the Victory Points of the Dragon Body cards they took during the round.
tuto.end-of-game: The game ends when a player reaches 50 points or more at the end of a round. The player with the highest total wins!
tuto.go: Now it's your turn to play, have fun!
